chapter: After Basie: Cafe Society to Los Angeles
title: Staying at the Dunbar Hotel and her friendship with Ivy Anderson
summary: On first coming to Los Angeles she used the Dunbar Hotel as headquarters, then stayed with various people. She became good friends with Ivy Anderson, played cards with her and sang at her funeral.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: And what did you do, did you find a place to stay or what did you do?
Well, I stayed at the Dunbar Hotel for I don't know how long.
I just kept that as headquarters. Then after I went around and

And you did that to be comfortable, yeah. I notice somewhere where you said you were very fond of that number that Ivy Anderson used to do, 'I'm Satisfied'.
I was just wondering because wasn't it about that time that Ivy started out here too?

Yes, and I hate to say it but I sang at her funeral.
Yeah. We used to be real good friends. We'd have little card sessions.
